landmark.text: Silt Side is a village on the coast of the Sea of Silt. It belongs to House Azeth, the merchant house of Kurn, and falls under the protection of the city state. Few raiders enter the area because of frequent patrols sent out by Fort Protector, so the villagers don't worry about attacks from the west. Giants from the silt aren't even a problem because, as nearby Fort Holz keeps them at bay. Silt Side handles trade with Eldaarich, which doesn't have a merchant house of its own. In fact, this village is the only connection with the outside world that Eldaarich maintains.
